REQUIREMENTS
Exchange students must have a strong IT, mathematics & algorithmic background.
A one-year exchange is possible for both Fall and Spring intakes.
(Year 3 – only available on the Lyon campus for a full year, while the Paris campus can only accept students for the Fall semester)
 IMPORTANT: Students cannot mix courses of different levels or options due to scheduling conflicts.

5. HEALTH / MEDICAL
COVER
All students are required to have health insurance.
• For EU Citizens: European Health Insurance
and/or Private International Insurance
• For Non-EU Citizens: French Social Security
(Compulsory), Private International Insurance
(Recommended)

8. EPI BUDDY
The EPITA’S Buddy Program is a sponsorship program that
connects an international student with a local EPITA
student.
The aim is to facilitate the integration of international
students while promoting the intercultural experience.
If you want to get to know better your new city, campus and
the student life around here, this program is made for you!
